description: This file defines the PolynomialBestFit class used for performing polynomial regression analysis within the PhpSpreadsheet library, specifically for trend analysis in spreadsheets. It includes methods for calculating the polynomial coefficients, evaluating the polynomial at specific points, and constructing the regression model.

classes.name: PolynomialBestFit
classes.description: A class for performing polynomial regression (best fit) analysis on data within the PhpSpreadsheet library, capable of calculating polynomial coefficients and equations.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the order (degree) of the polynomial used for the regression.

methods.name: getValueOfYForX
methods.description: Calculates the Y-value for a given X-value based on the polynomial regression.

methods.name: getValueOfXForY
methods.description: Calculates the X-value for a given Y-value based on the polynomial regression.

methods.name: getEquation
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the polynomial equation.

methods.name: getSlope
methods.description: Returns the slope coefficients of the polynomial, optionally rounded to a specified decimal place.

methods.name: getCoefficients
methods.description: Returns all polynomial coefficients including the intercept, optionally rounded.

methods.name: polynomialRegression
methods.description: Performs the regression analysis to compute polynomial coefficients based on provided data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PolynomialBestFit object and performs the regression if conditions are met.
